info.title: ExtraHop
info.description: REST API for ExtraHop RevealX 360, the SaaS network detection and response (NDR) platform. Authentication: OAuth 2.0 client credentials. Full v1 REST API resource surface (configuration, detections, metrics, records, packets, system administration).

servers.description: RevealX 360 API endpoint host, from the RevealX 360 API Access page. Replace CCP-HOST with the tenant-specific API host (Itential Platform Integration Models require a static server URL rather than OpenAPI server variables).
